rationale: Rear-end collision caused by another vehicle, resulting in a totaled car and injury to the policyholder; directly falls under auto coverage.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15 AM. The at-fault vehicle was traveling ~35 mph with no braking; claimant's vehicle is totaled with structural damage from trunk to back seat. Claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Police report filed with at-fault driver's insurance information available.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: filed; other driver's insurance info on report

rationale: Tree damage to a parked vehicle falls under auto comprehensive coverage, which explicitly includes weather-related damage to insured vehicles.
claim_summary: Tree fall from claimant's front yard struck parked vehicle in driveway during wind event last night, causing damage to hood and windshield. Policy is active bundle home/auto with $1,000 deductible. High-severity claim requiring vehicle inspection and repair assessment.

case_facts.description: maple tree from claimant's yard fell in wind, struck parked vehicle
